Title: Generally Available: Custom domain support and push delivery to webhooks highlight new Azure Event Grid releases

Body.Content:
New capabilities in Azure Event Grid add functionality to the MQTT broker feature and to Namespace topics – as well as enhanced security options. 

 

Generally Available features: 

  • Namespace topic push delivery to webhook endpoints  

    • Support for webhook endpoints in Azure Event Grid namespace topics allows for efficient and reliable push delivery to webhooks, expanding the possibilities for event-driven architectures and integrations. 

  • MQTT broker feature - custom domain support 

    • Custom domain names support in Azure Event Grid’s MQTT broker makes it possible to assign your own domain names to the MQTT and HTTP endpoints within your Azure Event Grid namespaces. This enhances security and simplifies client configuration. Additionally, assigning custom domain names to namespaces can help improve availability, manage capacity, and facilitate cross-region client mobility. 

Public Preview features: 

  • Cross-tenant delivery support 

    • Cross-tenant delivery support to Event Hub, Service Bus, and Storage Queues using managed identity with federated identity credentials (FIC) in Azure Event Grid topics, domains, system topics and partner topics. 

  • Namespace topic to namespace topic forwarding 

    • Namespace topic to namespace topic forwarding, enables seamless event forwarding between topics hosted in the same or different namespaces, simplifying event routing and management.
